title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: PGA Tour Schedule Shakeup
items.text: The PGA Tour announced Sompo as the new title sponsor for Napa’s fall event, rebranding it the Sompo Championship and moving it to a new venue as a Championship Series event in 2028.

items.headline: Kisner on Tiger and Bryson
items.text: Kevin Kisner credited Tiger Woods for normalizing on-course theatrical antics, saying it set the stage for Bryson DeChambeau's exaggerated swing reactions in 2026.
